omar-sales: Hey team — need a recommended flow for provisioning a hosted API key for an enterprise POC (Acme). Requirements: 1) key scoped only to inference (no billing admin), 2) expires after 7 days, 3) IP allowlist for Acme CIDR, 4) audit trail so security can prove key was rotated/revoked. Running into a customer ask for automatic rotation webhooks too. Any simple ops we can give them?

jess-sec: +1 to scoping. For POCs we prefer short-lived, scoped keys and an approval ticket. We usually ask sales to create a ticket in jira:SEC-PROV with customer CIDR + POC owner. Security will sign off and create the key.

liam-devex: If you want self-serve guidance: Console -> Settings -> API Keys -> Create key -> Name it like "acme-poc-ephemeral" -> Scopes: select "inference:read, inference:write" -> Expires: 7d -> IP allowlist: paste CIDR. That will give you a single-use token with expiry. Share the token once via the secure channel.

omar-sales: Nice. Does the console show who created it and when so Acme can see audit logs? They want proof of rotation.

jess-sec: Yes — the Console writes audit events. If you need an exported log for the contract, open a ticket to get a signed export (we redact internal IDs). For basic proof, screenshots + the audit row (creator, timestamp, action=create) usually suffice.

eva-soleng: For automation we expose an admin token-based API for programmatic key creation and rotation (internal). Example curl we give to partners with a customer-specific admin token: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"name":"acme-poc-ephemeral","scopes":["inference:generate"],"expires_at":"2024-12-01T00:00:00Z","ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24"]}'
```
That returns the key and an id you can use to rotate or revoke. We should only share that API with Solutions Eng or with a special service account.

omar-sales: Can we provide them a one-click rotation webhook? They asked for automatic rotate every 24h during the POC.

liam-devex: We don't expose a public webhook for auto rotation by default. Workaround: create a tiny lambda in their infra that calls our admin keys endpoint with a service account token to create + distribute a new key, then call revoke on the old key id. We can provide a sample script.

jess-sec: If they want auto-rotation, insist on using a customer-managed secret store. Rotation through our admin API is fine, but you must ensure the service account token is restricted and audited. For enterprise POCs, we recommend: 1) short-lived keys from Console (7d) OR 2) programmatic rotation using an integration account + restricted admin token + per-rotation audit entries.

omar-sales: OK. Can you add a concise how-to we can paste into the SOW / email to Acme? They need steps and timeline.

eva-soleng: Draft to paste: 1) Create a scoped hosted API key named acme-poc-ephemeral with scopes limited to inference. 2) Set expiry to 7 days. 3) Add Acme CIDR to IP allowlist. 4) Provide token over secure channel and confirm receipt. 5) At day 6 we rotate: create new key, update their secret store, revoke old key. For automation we can provide a sample rotation script and admin API details under NDA.

omar-sales: Perfect. I'll send that and open a jira:SEC-PROV ticket with the CIDR and POC owner. Any quick CLI snippets for rotation/revoke to include?

liam-devex: Revoke example: 
```
# revoke by id
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/KEY_ID/revoke \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Create returns JSON {"id":"<KEY_ID>","key":"sk_live_..."} Make sure to never paste sk_live in commit history.

sre-bot: [automated] Audit event: API key created by eva-soleng (id=key_abc123) at 2024-11-12T15:03:20Z :white_check_mark:

omar-sales: Thanks everyone — I'll follow the steps and loop in security. If Acme wants us to run the rotation lambda we can scope a SE timeboxed task.

eva-soleng: Happy to help. If Sec needs the export for contract, ping me and I'll attach the audit CSV. :thumbsup:

jess-sec: Approved path. We'll expedite the ticket once the SOW line-item is added.
